result.brief: SCION 在单一像素空间编码器中联合自监督对比表征学习与流匹配生成，用 [CLS] 语义表征自条件生成，无需标签或预训练模型，为视觉表征与生成潜空间对齐提供新思路。
result.reason: Joint self-supervised representation and generative learning in one pixel-space encoder with [CLS] semantic tokens and flow matching; directly addresses visual representation learning and generative latent/representation alignment without pretraining.
